title: pilosella hoppeana subsp. troica
intro: Pilosella hoppeana subsp. troica, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, that can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella hoppeana subsp. troica include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antifungal properties, making it a valuable resource in natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
